p: Widnes Road runs through the middle of Widnes town centre, close to the main shops and market. The town grew up around the chemical industry, and that story is told at Catalyst Science Discovery Centre down by the river at Spike Island, which is a good hands-on day out for the kids.

Spike Island itself is a lovely green spot for a walk along the Mersey and the old canal, with views of the Silver Jubilee Bridge and the newer Mersey Gateway, which links Widnes with Runcorn across the river.
Reel Time is strictly 18+, so bring ID if you're likely to be asked.
